title: Jewel Toned Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A resinous and flavorful Argentinian beef stew featuring star anise, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this sugar-free-friendly dish is simmered in a nimono-style broth
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef pieces on all sides
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set it aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook until it begins to soften
Add the ground star anise, tomato paste, beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew cool slightly before serving
